title: Indian Books On Atheism
tags: how to be an atheist in india
description:
India has a long history of free thought and rationalism, but many voices often remain unheard in mainstream discussions. In this video, we explore the works of three legendary Indian atheist authors — Ravichandran C, Narendra Dabholkar, and Dr Abraham Kovoor — and how their writings shaped the rationalist movement in India.

We’ll look at:

Ravichandran C — author of groundbreaking works in Malayalam promoting atheism and rationalist thought.

Narendra Dabholkar — the fearless activist whose book “The Case for Reason” inspired countless Indians to question superstition.

Dr Abraham Kovoor — author of “Begone Godmen”, who exposed fake spiritual gurus across India and Sri Lanka.

This video highlights how their books, activism, and legacy continue to empower free thinkers and challenge blind faith in Indian society.

If you’re looking to read Indian voices on atheism, these authors are the best place to start.
#AtheismInIndia #Rationalism #indianauthors
